t: This 4lite Torre Single 4ft LED Batten delivers versatile and energy-efficient illumination for various indoor settings. Featuring a robust polycarbonate body and slimline design, this LED lighting solution is ideal for garages, workshops, and dry storage areas within commercial, industrial, or residential properties. Installers benefit from quick and easy fitting due to push-fit terminals and BESA fixing points. With adjustable wattage options of 20W or 40W, and colour temperature selectable between 3000K, 4000K, and 5700K, it provides adaptable bright light up to 5400 lumens. This durable 1200mm LED batten is a long-lasting and practical lighting choice.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
